description: Publishes a document: makes its .md URL public, adds it to the site llms.txt and pushes it to the customer server when auto-deploy is configured. On this account the call is refused until user_approved is true.

lang.description: Language code, e.g. en, pl. Defaults to the site language.

site.description: Site domain, e.g. example.com. Optional when the account has one site.

user_approved.description: True only after the user has seen this exact change in the chat and agreed to it.

name: publish_document
title: Publish document
